name: Mara Venn
description: A fixture at the Crooked Hour's back tables, more trusted by the house than most of its actual runners — and she hears more sitting there than most watchmen do walking a beat. Sharp-eyed, unhurried, and openly unimpressed by rank.
title: Wagering Ring Regular
initialDialogue: Another broadsheet gone quiet and nobody's talking. Funny how that keeps happening to the ones printing the truth.
